blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.
blocks.zh: 像素空间基因 变形器通常每个图像补丁都使用一款令牌,因此捕捉更细细的细节需要更多的使使全球注意力越来越昂贵. 我们注意到,更细化的细节并不一定需要更多的全球交流:低频结构得益于全球交流,而高频的细节可以在当地建模. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了 SpecSlot,一个像素-空间修正-流量变换器,它将输出细节与全球关注序列的长度脱钩. 光谱 槽将每个空间锚地扩展为多个槽,每个槽都指定了DCT系数的脱联带;这将锚地密度与光谱分解区分开来. 只有来自每个主播的最低频段参与全球关注,而所有频段都在当地互动. 这使得模型可以在不扩大全球序列的情况下增加光谱细节. 空间头进一步为光谱预测增加了局部校正,而基因状态,目标,和丢失则仍然停留在像素空间. 在ImageNet-256上,SpecSlot实现了可比较的最终FID到FLOPs相配的JiT控制,同时更快地聚合. 在ImageNet-512上,它比控制改进了2.84,减少了3.9%的FLOP,并且仅以38.2%的低成本进入了JiT-B/16的0.69FID. 在文本到图像生成上,SpecSlot在DPG-Bench上以40.6%的远期成本以1.06的比分超越了JiT-B/8.

blocks.en: 1   Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pixel-space generative models learn directly from noise to pixels, eliminating the separately trained autoencoder and its compression bottleneck. This simplicity, however, comes with a computational cost: the full-resolution image must be represented as Transformer tokens. Most pixel-space Transformers use one token per spatial patch, so the patch grid simultaneously determines what the model reads, what each token predicts, and how many tokens participate in global attention. As a result, finer image detail directly increases attention cost: on a 256 × 256 256\times 256 image, reducing the patch size from 16 × 16 16\times 16 to 8 × 8 8\times 8 increases the token count from 256 to 1,024, making the quadratic term of dense attention 16 × 16\times larger.

blocks.en: Existing methods address this cost from different directions, but largely retain the coupling between output detail and token communication. JiT routes every patch token through the global sequence [ 34 ] . Multiscale systems move detail to extra stages or detailer heads [ 52 , 9 , 22 ] , and efficient-attention methods shorten the sequence with generic patterns—windows, selected global tokens, or learned sparsity [ 36 , 4 , 31 , 55 ] . Spectral Forcing brings in frequency structure, but only to filter the noisy input; its tokens remain spatial patches [ 19 ] . Across the pixel-space generators discussed above, output detail remains tied to a spatial patch grid, even when communication is compressed or restricted.
blocks.zh: 现有方法从不同方向解决这一费用问题,但基本上保留了产出细节和象征性通信之间的结合。 JiT通过全局序列将每个补丁符号都通向 [34]. 多尺度系统将细节移动到额外的阶段或更细化的头部[52,9,22],高效的注意方法会以通用的图案来缩短序列——窗口,所选择的全球标志,或学会了斯帕克语 [36, 4, 31, 55]. Spectraral Forcing带来了频率结构,但只是为了过滤出吵闹的输入;其符号仍然是空间补丁 [19]. 在上文讨论的像素-空间发电机中,输出细节仍与空间补丁网格相接,即使通信被压缩或限制。

blocks.en: Our key observation is that finer detail does not necessarily require proportionally more global communication: in the frequency domain, low-frequency structure carries broad image organization and benefits from long-range exchange, while fine detail is largely local. A token carrying broad structure therefore stands to gain from exchanging with the whole image, while a token carrying fine detail mostly does not. Yet in existing designs, what a token communicates is fixed by where it sits, not by what it produces. Can a token’s output role also determine how it should communicate?
blocks.zh: 我们的关键观察是,更细细的细节并不一定需要成比例地更多的全球交流:在频率域中,低频结构带有宽广的图像组织并受益于远程交流,而细细的细节主要是局部的. 因此,一个具有广泛结构的标志将受益于与整个图像的交换,而一个带有详细细节的标志则大多没有。 然而,在现有的设计中,什么符号的交流是固定在它的位置,而不是它生产的东西. 一个符号的输出作用能否决定它应该如何沟通?

blocks.en: SpecSlot builds on this idea by making output roles explicit and using them to control communication. It organizes computation around three operations: Read , Allocate , and Route . Read forms a grid of spatial anchors that collect input evidence. Allocate expands each anchor into K K indexed slots, with each slot assigned a disjoint radial group of DCT coefficients. Route then uses these spectral roles to decide communication: only the slot assigned the lowest-frequency group from each anchor enters the global stage, while all slots interact locally within the anchor. This separates fine-grained output representation from the length of the global sequence. A spatial head further reuses the same slot states to add a local correction to the spectral prediction, without introducing additional tokens. Figure 2 illustrates this design.
blocks.zh: SpecSlot通过明确输出角色并使用它们来控制通信,以此为基础. 它围绕三个操作组织计算:读取、分配和路由。 读取形成收集输入证据的空间锚地网格. 分配每个锁定扩展为 KK 索引槽, 每个槽指定一个 DCT 系数的离线组 。 然后路由使用这些光谱角色来决定通信:只有槽从每个锚上分配出最低频组进入全球舞台,而所有槽则在锚上内部进行局部交互. 这将精细的输出表示与全局序列的长度区分开来. 一个空间头会进一步再利用同位子状态来给光谱预测添加局部的校正,而不会引入额外的符号. 图2说明了这一设计。

blocks.en: This representation exposes two separate allocation variables. W W controls the density of spatial anchors, while K K controls the spectral subdivision at each anchor. The total number of slots grows with W ​ K WK , but the global image sequence contains only W W carriers. A fixed token budget can therefore be allocated either to denser spatial anchors or to finer spectral roles without forcing both to increase together. This turns tokenization from a single patch-size choice into an explicit quality–compute allocation problem.
blocks.zh: 这一表述揭示出两个不同的分配变量。 W控制了空间锚地的密度,而K控制了每个锚地的光谱子分区. 槽的总数会随着W K WK而增长,但全局图像序列只包含W载体. 因此,固定的符号预算可以分配给更密集的空间锚地,也可以分配给更细化的光谱作用,而不会迫使两者一起增加。 这使得符号化从单一的补丁大小选择变成了一个明确的质量-计算分配问题.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We introduce an indexed W × K W\times K representation in which spatial anchors collect input evidence and slots receive disjoint spectral coefficient groups. The split exposes anchor density and coefficient subdivision as separate allocation variables, and the same slot states also decode a local pixel correction. • We define carrier-routed global–global–local–local (GGLL) attention from the slot index: one lowest-radial carrier per anchor enters global blocks, and all slots enter anchor-local blocks, so the global sequence contains W W carriers rather than W ​ K WK slots. • On ImageNet-256 and ImageNet-512, SpecSlot provides two measured quality–compute operating points between JiT’s low-cost and high-cost settings. At ImageNet-512, W256/K4 lowers FID by 2.84 over our FLOPs-matched JiT control (JiT-CM) with 3.9% fewer GFLOPs, and trails JiT-B/16 by 0.69 FID at 38.2% lower cost. Larger output windows cover more pixels while the global sequence remains fixed; the larger improvement over JiT-CM is consistent with this within-anchor allocation. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot likewise surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

blocks.en: 2   Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion and score-based models learn to reverse a gradual noising process and provide the iterative foundation of modern image synthesis [ 24 , 47 , 14 ] . Rectified flow turns the same idea into a straight noise-to-data path [ 35 ] . Latent diffusion moved this process into the latent space of a separately trained autoencoder, and improved autoencoders continue to strengthen this line [ 17 , 45 , 54 ] . DiT, U-ViT, and SiT showed that plain Transformers scale reliably in this setting [ 41 , 3 , 37 ] . Pixel-space generation removes the autoencoder, but then asks the model to process the full-resolution state. This line has followed several routes: Simple Diffusion and Hourglass DiT reduce the state internally, cascaded models and PixelFlow distribute generation across resolutions, and JiT shows that a direct large-patch Transformer can remain a strong pixel-space baseline [ 27 , 11 , 25 , 8 , 34 ] . Detail recovery is then assigned to extra components: PixelDiT adds a pixel-level DiT, DiP adds a detailer head, HyperDiT connects coarse and fine flows, and PixNerd decodes patch tokens with a neural field [ 52 , 9 , 22 , 50 ] . These designs differ in where the compute goes, but share one premise: a token is a spatial patch, so finer detail and wider communication stay tied to the same spatial grid. SpecSlot complements this line with a single-backbone allocation: indexed slots carry fixed output and communication roles, so detail can be subdivided without making every output token global.
blocks.zh: 分化和分数模型学习倒转逐渐点名的过程,为现代图像合成提供迭接基础[24,47,14]. 已校正的流将同一种想法变为直通噪声到数据路径[35]. Lentent spission将这一过程推入了单独训练的自编码器的潜在空间,改进后自编码器继续强化了这条线[17,45,54]. DiT,U-ViT,和SiT显示,平面变形器在这个设置中可以可靠地分级 [41, 3, 37]. 像素-空间生成会去掉自定义编码器,但随后会要求模型处理全解析状态. 这条线路遵循了多条路线:简单分流和Hourglass DiT减少内部状态,级联模型和像素Flow在分辨率间分布生成,而JiT显示,一直接的大平面变换器可以保持强像素-空间基线[27,11,25,8,34]. 详细恢复后被分配到额外的组件:像素DIT添加了像素级的DiT,DiP添加了细节头,HyperDiT连接了粗细和精细的流量,而PixNerd解码了有神经场的补丁符 [52,9,22,50]. 这些设计在计算去向上有所不同,但有一个前提:一个符号是空间补丁,因此更细细的细节和更广泛的通信会一直绑在同一空间网格上. SpecSlot以单后骨分配来补充这行:索引的插槽带有固定的输出和通信角色,因此细节可以细分,而不使每个输出符号都变成全局.

blocks.en: Frequency offers a complementary view of this problem. It has entered generative modeling through the state or forward process, through generation order or conditioning, and through the training objective or analysis. In the first line, inverse heat dissipation, wavelet models, sparse transform codes, and DCTdiff change the representation or process used for generation [ 44 , 21 , 43 , 39 , 40 ] . In the second, VAR and NFIG organize generation by scale or frequency, while Spectral Forcing and Frequency-Forcing use frequency-related conditioning or guidance; Latent Forcing instead reorders the trajectory with a semantic auxiliary stream [ 49 , 29 , 19 , 2 , 16 ] . Focal frequency loss reweights spectral errors, and Fourier-space analyses characterize diffusion without changing the denoiser [ 32 , 18 ] . Recent architectural methods make frequency roles part of the denoiser itself: DiMSUM alternates spatial and wavelet-subband processing, while DeCo assigns low and high frequencies to a DiT and a separate pixel decoder [ 42 , 38 ] . Together these works show several ways for frequency to shape representation or generation, but the cited lines do not use fixed spectral groups as both per-token output ownership and communication eligibility within one pixel-space backbone. SpecSlot keeps the state, target, and loss in pixel space; fixed, disjoint DCT groups give slots spectral roles, and the role index also determines which slots communicate globally.
blocks.zh: 频率是对这一问题的补充。 它通过状态或前进过程,通过生成顺序或条件,以及通过培训目标或分析,进入了基因模型。 在一行中,逆热散去,波浪模型,稀疏变换代码,DCTdiff改变用于生成的表示或过程[44,21,43,39,40]. 在第二个中,VAR和NFIG按尺度或频率组织生成,而Spectral Forcing和频率-forcing则使用与频率相关的调制或制导;Latet Forcing转而以语义辅助流来重排轨迹[49,29,19,2,16]. 焦频损失重取光谱误差,而傅里叶-空间分析则在不改变分光器的情况下定性扩散[32,18]. 近期的建筑设计方法使频率角色成为了denoiser本身的一部分: DiMSUM可替代空间和波段子波段处理,而DeCo则将低频和高频分配到一个DiT和一个单独的像素解码器[42,38]. 这些作品加在一起显示了几条频率来塑造表示或生成的方法,但被引用的行并不使用固定的光谱组,作为一像素-空间主干线内的每位输出所有权和通信资格. 光谱 Slot在像素空间中保持状态,目标,和丢失;固定的,脱节的DCT组给出了插槽光谱角色,而角色索引也决定了哪个插槽进行全球通信.

blocks.en: Vision Transformers tokenize an image into a spatial patch grid [ 15 ] , and NaViT extends this idea to variable resolutions [ 12 ] . This line reduces sequence work by changing how many spatial tokens are retained or processed at each step: ToMe merges similar tokens, SparseDiT prunes them, DyDiT++ reschedules computation across denoising time and space, variable-length tokenization learns a global merge, and FlexiDiT spends fewer tokens at easier steps [ 5 , 6 , 53 , 33 , 1 ] . The spatial patch remains the allocation unit, so detail and communication stay coupled to the same grid. SpecSlot adds a second, spectral axis: each of W W anchors owns K K slots with disjoint coefficient groups, making the fixed budget N = W ​ K N{=}WK an explicit split between anchor density and spectral subdivision.
blocks.zh: Vision Transformers将一幅图像以符号化为空间补丁网格[15],而NaViT将这个想法延伸至可变分辨率[12]. 此行通过改变每个步骤保留或处理多少个空间符来减少序列工作: ToMe合并了相类似的符号,SparseDiT将它们推开,DyDiT++重排计算跨越去诺时间和空间,可变长的符号化学习了全局合并,而FlexiDiT在更轻松的步骤上花费更少的符号[5,6,53,33,1]. 空间补丁仍然是分配单位,因此细节和通信保持同网格相接. 光谱 斯洛特增加了第二个光谱轴:W锚地中每个W锚地都拥有有脱联系数组的K K槽,使固定预算N=W K NQQQ WK在锚地密度和光谱分层之间明确划分.

blocks.en: The communication literature provides the other half of the problem by restricting how tokens exchange information. Swin uses local windows with shifted boundaries, Longformer combines local windows with a few global tokens, and Perceiver routes information through a small latent bottleneck [ 36 , 4 , 31 ] . In pixel-space generation, RINs exchange information through learned interface states, while trainable sparse attention and PixSGR learn or select interaction patterns from the data [ 30 , 55 , 51 ] . These approaches provide useful local or global topologies, but do not tie communication eligibility to a fixed spectral output role. SpecSlot fixes the graph from the allocation: one lowest-frequency slot per anchor is the global carrier, and all slots interact locally, so cross-anchor communication is spent on the role that also carries the low-frequency scaffold.
blocks.zh: 通信文献通过限制信使如何交流信息提供了另一半问题。 斯温使用有变换边界的本地窗口,Longformer将本地窗口与几个全球符号结合,而Perceiver路线信息通过一个小的潜在瓶颈[36,4,31]. 在像素-空间生成中,RINs通过学习到的界面状态来交换信息,而可训练的稀疏关注和PixSGR则从数据中学习或选择交互模式[30,55,51]. 这些方法提供了有用的当地或全球地貌,但不把通信资格与固定光谱输出作用挂钩。 光谱 分槽从分配中修正出图:每个锚一个最低频槽是全球载体,所有分槽都在当地交互,因此跨分槽的通信都花在同样搭载低频脚手架的角色上.

blocks.en: 3   Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: SpecSlot organizes pixel-space generation around one idea: tokenization as allocation—assigning each token a fixed output role and dividing a fixed token budget between anchor density and spectral subdivision. Global attention is then spent only on the role that needs it; the rectified-flow state, target, and loss remain in pixel space.
blocks.zh: SpecSlot围绕一个概念组织像素-空间生成: 以分配形式表示符号化——将每个符号分配出一个固定的输出角色,并在锚地密度和光谱子分区之间分配一个固定的符号预算. 然后,全球注意力只花在需要它的作用上;纠正后的流动状态、目标和损失仍然存在于像素空间中。

blocks.en: 3.2.3   Route: Carrier and Local Attention
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 路线:承运人和地方关注

blocks.en: The third question is who needs to communicate globally. Sending every slot through global attention would make the global quadratic cost grow with K K —reintroducing exactly the coupling between output detail and communication cost that the slot allocation set out to remove. The spectral roles suggest a cheaper split: the lowest radial group holds the broad structure that benefits from cross-anchor exchange, while finer groups are increasingly local; its signal also overtakes the noise earliest in the flow (Section 6.2 ). SpecSlot therefore routes by role: the owner of the lowest radial group, slot 0 0 , is the carrier and the only slot entering the global stage; all K K slots then mix locally within their anchor. Since global and local blocks alternate, the carrier brings global information into its anchor and takes local detail back into the next global stage.
blocks.zh: 第三个问题是,谁需要在全球进行沟通。 通过全球关注发送每一个时间段,将使全球四相成本随着KK的增长而增加,从而重新准确地将产出细节与分配时间段拟去掉的通信成本结合起来。 光谱作用表明,分裂是更便宜的:最底层的射线组具有从交叉射线交换中获益的广泛结构,而更细的组越来越局部;它的信号也超过了流中最早的噪音(第6.2节)。 光谱 因此按角色划分的槽:最低光圈组的拥有者为"0"槽,是航母和进入全球舞台的唯一槽;所有K槽后会在其锚地内进行本地混合. 由于全球和本地块交替出现,承运人将全球信息带入其锚地,并将本地细节带回下一个全球舞台.

blocks.en: On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot-K2 and SpecSlot-K4 are two measured, nondominated operating points between JiT-B/16 and JiT-B/8 (Table 1 ): K2 already improves over JiT-B/16, and K4 improves further while using 40.9% fewer FLOPs than JiT-B/8, which remains the quality leader. blocks.zh: 在ImageNet-256上,SpecSlot-K2和SpecSlot-K4是JiT-B/16和JiT-B/8之间的两个非主控操作点(表1):K2已经比JiT-B/16改进了,而K4在使用FLOP比JiT-B/8少了40.9%,后者仍然是质量领先者. JiT-CM给出了更紧密的计算比较:SpecSlot-K4在几乎相同的FLOP和吞吐量(Appendix D.)的5个种子间距内与其平均FID相匹配,在早期到中间的检查站下降更快(图4)。

blocks.en: At ImageNet-512, each anchor covers four times as many pixels as at ImageNet-256, while our global sequence stays at 288 tokens. Larger spectral windows and the spatial correction can accommodate the additional within-anchor detail without adding global communication, offering a possible explanation for SpecSlot’s larger margin at this resolution. SpecSlot-K4 improves FID by 2.84 over JiT-CM at slightly lower cost, and is only 0.69 FID behind JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost and 1.6 × 1.6\times higher throughput; it also attains the highest Inception Score in the panel, and both allocations outperform the input-side spectral baseline SF-B/32. The lower-cost SpecSlot-K2 stays within 1.04 FID of the control at 33.1% less compute.
blocks.zh: 在ImageNet-512,每个主播覆盖的像素是ImageNet-256的四倍,而我们的全球序列则停留在288个令牌上. 更大的光谱窗口和空间校正可以容纳额外的锁定内细节而无需增加全局通信,为斯佩克斯洛特在这个分辨率上的较大距离提供了可能的解释. SpecSlot-K4比JiT-CM改进了2.84的FID,成本略低,仅比JiT-B/16落后0.69的FID,成本降低38.2%,吞吐量提高1.6×1.6相;还取得了面板上最高的Inception分数,而且两者的拨款都超过了输入-侧光谱基线SF-B/32. 成本较低的SpecSlot-K2仍停留在控制线的1.04FID以33.1%的少计算.

These two operating points are consistent with the within-anchor allocation mechanism above, but do not by themselves isolate the cause of the larger margin.

blocks.en: 5.1   Understanding the Design
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 理解设计

blocks.en: 5.1.1   Anchor Density and Coefficient Subdivision
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 锚地密度和系数分区

blocks.en: Both allocation axes trade compute for quality, but they are not interchangeable: W W improves the read, K K refines the write (Table 4 ). Increasing K K at fixed W W lowers FID at higher cost with diminishing returns—the last doubling buys only 0.31 FID—while shifting the split toward more anchors at fixed N N lowers FID monotonically, with no clear saturation in this range. Within the tested N = 2,048 N{=}2{,}048 configurations, these trends favor allocating more of the token budget to spatial anchors; we do not claim that this rule generalizes beyond the measured range.
blocks.zh: 两种分配轴都计算出质量,但不能互换:WW改进读取,KK改进写取(表4. 以固定W W 增加K 以更低的成本降低FID,同时回报率不断下降——最后一次双倍只购买了0.31 FID——同时将分割转向在固定N N 下方的FID单调下更多的锚地,在这一范围内没有明显的饱和. 在被测试的 N = 2,048 N{=}2{,}048 配置中,这些趋势倾向于将更多的符号预算分配给空间锚地;我们并不声称这一规则被概括到所测量范围以外.

blocks.en: At fixed W W and B B , the entropy-effective slot fraction decreases monotonically from 0.803 at K = 2 K{=}2 to 0.495 at K = 8 K{=}8 (Table 5 ). The absolute effective rank still grows, but sublinearly, so token count alone does not measure effective capacity. This utilization pattern is consistent with the diminishing quality gains at larger K K and motivates our choice of K2 as the lower-cost point and K4 as the intermediate point.
blocks.zh: 在固定的W W和B B 中,同位素有效的插槽分数单调地从 K = 2 K{=}2 降至 K = 8 K{=}8 (表5). 绝对有效的排名仍然在增长,但从线下看,因此光靠象征性的计算并不能衡量有效的能力. 这种利用模式与较大的K K 质量增益不断下降相一致,并促使我们选择K2作为较低成本点,K4作为中间点。

blocks.en: 5.1.2   Input and Output Representations
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 投入和产出说明

blocks.en: At the same spectral output, spatial input surpasses frequency input, and the dual-basis hybrid achieves the best FID: 6.59, a further 0.40 below the best single-basis variant at 6.99, without adding tokens or cross-anchor attention edges (Table 4 (b)). This margin indicates that the two output bases are not redundant: the spatial correction supplies structure that the spectral base alone misses. Section 6.1 localizes this complementarity over the flow and across frequency bands.
blocks.zh: 在同一光谱输出时,空间输入会超过频率输入,双基杂交实现最佳FID:6.59,比6.99的最佳单基变体再低0.40,而不会增加符号或跨指针的注意力边缘(表4(b). 这一比值表明,这两个输出基并非多余:光谱基缺失的空间校正供给结构. 第6.1节将流动和跨频段的互补性本地化。

blocks.en: 5.1.3   Carrier Routing
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 承运人路线

blocks.en: To test routing at a fixed forward budget, we train a full-global control (Dense-global-CM) on the same W ​ 256 / K ​ 4 W256/K4 configuration, replacing the carrier/local schedule with 12 full-global blocks over all 1,024 image slots; its hidden width is 560, matching the measured GGLL forward cost. GGLL is both better and faster than this control at essentially identical FLOPs (Table 3 ). Full-global attention reaches a lower FID but at 74.8% higher cost and lower throughput. The carrier design therefore targets the intermediate, attention-constrained regime, saving 42.8% of the full-global cost. GLGL keeps the same carrier set and global budget but alternates the global/local order; its FID degrades at identical compute, showing that block order affects performance under this fixed carrier set. Section 6.2 provides a possible motivation for early global processing: the lowest-radial role is recovered earliest in the flow.
blocks.zh: 为了在固定的前沿预算中测试路由,我们在相同的W 256/K 4 W256/K4配置上培训了全全球控制(Dense-global-CM),在所有1,024个图像槽上以12个全全球块取代了载体/地表;其隐藏宽度为560,与测量的GGLL前置成本相匹配. GGLL在基本相同的FLOP上,比这个控制更好和更快(表3). 全球关注程度较低,但成本高74.8%,吞吐量低。 因此,承运人设计的目标是中间的、受注意力限制的制度,节省了全球全部成本的42.8%。 GLGL 保持相同的航母集和全球预算,但替代全球/局部秩序;其FID以相同的计算方式降解,显示块序会影响该固定航母集下的性能. 第6.2节为早期全球加工提供了可能的动力:最下射线作用最早被恢复到流量.

blocks.en: 7   Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: SpecSlot recasts tokenization as allocation: a fixed token budget is split between anchor density and spectral subdivision, while global attention is assigned by role. On ImageNet-256, it reaches a comparable final FID to the FLOPs-matched JiT control and descends faster early in training; on ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over that control and approaches JiT-B/16 at 38% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, the same design surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench (62.21 vs. 61.15) at 40.6% lower forward cost. These results show that, in the evaluated pixel-space settings, output detail and global-communication cost can be decoupled through tokenization. Our diagnostics find the lowest-radial role is recovered earliest, supporting its use as the carrier. Allocation gives pixel-space models a new way to trade detail for communication.
blocks.zh: SpecSlot重制了标语化作为分配:固定标语化预算在锚地密度和光谱分块之间分出,而全球注意力则按角色分配. 在ImageNet-256上,它达到了与FLOPs相匹配的JiT控制相类似的最终FID,并在早期的训练中下降得更快;在ImageNet-512上,它比该控制改进了2.84的FID,并以38%的成本接近了JiT-B/16. 在文本到图像生成方面,同一设计在DPG-Bench(62.21 vs 61.15)上以40.6%的远期成本超过了JiT-B/8. 这些结果表明,在被评价的像素-空间设置中,输出细节和全球-通信成本可以通过象征性化来解开. 我们的诊断发现最小的射线作用是最早恢复的,支持它作为载体的使用. 分配给像素-空间模型换取通信细节的新方式.

blocks.en: Thus adding slots can slightly improve teacher-forced fitting without providing the same number of independent, strongly coupled directions. blocks.en: F.1   ImageNet examples

blocks.en: Figure 9 compares selected ImageNet-256 generations from JiT-CM and SpecSlot W256/K4 under the same class and noise draw. In these pairs, SpecSlot renders class-specific fine structure more coherently: feather boundaries are clearer for brambling, chickadee, and rooster; the cornet has more regular tubing and bell geometry; and the boathouse preserves sharper roofline and reflection structure. It also reduces visible local distortions in the anemone fish, banister, and barrel examples, where contours or repeated parts are less coherent in the JiT-CM samples. The hay example shows a more regular field-scale texture.
